name: Lovable Cloud
desc: Built-in database, login and file storage for apps Lovable builds.
desc_zh: 为 Lovable 生成的应用提供内置数据库、登录与文件存储。
solves: A prompt-built app stops the moment it needs accounts or a place to keep data; the backend is already wired into the project.
solves_zh: 纯靠提示词搭出来的应用一需要账号和存数据就卡住；现在后端已经接在项目里。
best_for: You described an app that needs users to sign in and their data to survive a refresh.
best_for_zh: 你想做的应用需要用户登录，并且刷新后数据还在。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — docs.lovable.dev/changelog (702 dated entries read)）。 First-party changelog entry dated Oct 6, 2025. Not in the ledger, so recorded under brief rule (b). It is a capability inside the Lovable product rather than a separate app, but it has its own docs surface and is what users search for when a Lovable app needs a backend. 首次公开日期来源：https://docs.lovable.dev/changelog
